goal: MoSCoW, RICE, WSJF, Kano, risk-first, dependency-first, and milestone-first ranking is explainable and overridable with audit
scenarios: the catalog lists moscow, rice, wsjf, kano, risk-first, dependency-first, and milestone-first
a project can select a prioritization method
a WorkItem stores the inputs needed by the selected method
ranking output is explainable and traceable to inputs
ranked Story output feeds the Story priority queue
users can override ranking with an audit reason
customers cannot select a prioritization method
constraints: specialist agents are out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
